New Editor ItemsOrbs and Pads
White orb and pad: Flips gravity and sends the player down quickly as a black orb and pad does
Black pad: Works like a black orb, but automatic.
Green pad: Works like a green orb, but automatic
Teleport orb: Teleports between two orbs across X and Y.
Customizable orb and pad: Can have whatever orb or pad function you want it to and the Orb trigger can change it at any time.
Portals
Plane gamemode portal. The Plane gamemode is similar to the ship and wave. When you move up, it moves up in the way the ship would, but it doesn't go down in air. It stays at the same Y position until the button is pressed again. The duration of an input is what determines how far up or down it moves.
Flip Screen portal. This portal flips the screen entirely so that the ground is on top, which can be replicated with a 180 degree angle Camera trigger, but this makes it simpler and easier for new users to use.
